Name: Fire Breath
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
It's that time of year again, when everything gets so cold you find yourself wishing if only I could, say, breathe fire...

Well now you can! Or your Stardew Valley farmer can, anyway, which is almost as good!

Press and hold a configurable hotkey ([b]Insert[/b] by default) to breathe fire.

[size=4][b]Notes:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Fire hurts monsters.
[*]Fire annoys non-monsters.
[*]Fire damage and distance are configurable in the config.json file.
[*]By default, both damage and distance depend on your combat skill, so you will only get a fraction of both based on your combat skill level. You can turn this off in config.json.
[*]If you set the [b]FireSound [/b]value to "", it will not play a sound.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
